title: fix(ui): kanban, calendar, timeline and map draw the no-access state for a refused read
body:
Fixes #36010

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：看板、日历、时间线、地图这四种视图里，没有数据读取权限的人原来会看到一串英文服务器报错，现在看到和列表页一样的「无权访问」提示，按自己的语言显示。
- 为什么做：这是甘特图同类修复的收尾，把同一问题在其余四种视图里一次补齐。
- 出错会怎样：只影响被拒读这一种情况；服务器故障、断网仍显示原来的报错画面，改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes
The load-error branch of `ObjectKanban`, `ObjectCalendar`, `ObjectTimeline` and `ObjectMap` now classifies a failed data load with the shared `classifyLoadError` (`@object-ui/react`). A `forbidden` verdict (a 403, or a `PERMISSION_DENIED` / `FORBIDDEN` code) draws the shared `DataEmptyState` (`role="status"`, Lock icon) with the existing `list.loadErrorForbiddenTitle` / `list.loadErrorForbiddenMessage` keys, and none of the server's text. Every other failure keeps each view's current error screen. This copies the Gantt pattern of PR #36006 view by view.

- Shared helper or copy: **copied per view**. No shared "load error to no-access" component exists, and adding one to `@object-ui/components` would be a new public export outside the claim's file surface.
- English fallbacks: kanban and timeline get two rows in their existing default-translation tables (`KANBAN_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, `TIMELINE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`), with the same text as the `en` pack. Calendar and map have no such table, so their `t()` calls carry `defaultValue` with the same text. No new i18n key.
- Icon: kanban and calendar already depend on `lucide-react` and use `Lock`. Timeline and map declare no icon library, so they use the shared `LazyIcon name="lock"` from `@object-ui/components` (same as `record-alert.tsx`), and no dependency is added.
- The map's tile-style failure (`mapStyleError`) is not a data load and is unchanged.
- The `ObjectKanban.tsx` changes are the import lines, two fallback rows and the load-error branch only (os-sales draft PR #35994 also edits that file).

## Tests
New pins sit in each view's existing load-error harness as a top-level `describe`: `ObjectKanban.errorClears-10663.test.tsx`, `ObjectCalendar.errorClears-10663.test.tsx`, `ObjectTimeline.errorClears-10663.test.tsx`, plus `ObjectMap.test.tsx` (map has no load-error harness). In each one, a 403 with `httpStatus` and `code` draws `*-no-access` with `role="status"`, the en sentence, and no `Error`, `PERMISSION_DENIED` or `HTTP 403` text. CONTROL: a 500 keeps the existing error screen.

## Acceptance notes
- A2 (browser reading) was not done. Setting up a showcase object with a kanban or calendar view and a refused read is not cheap here. The unit pins drive the real component through a data source that throws the adapter's 403 shape.
- `useTimelineTranslation` comments say the table is the "byte-identical twin of `en.ts`". The two new rows match `en.ts` `list.loadErrorForbidden*` text exactly.
